name: thekra
description: Thekra (تذكرة) — on-demand Islamic reminder app monorepo (structure + schema phase).

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm --filter backend exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter frontend exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
